$comment: The website's features (rayzr.app/features and the landing page's highlights). Add one when a feature lands: title, a one-sentence description, a Starlight icon name, its docs page (a docs/site.json slug), a group, and highlight: true for the landing page (keep about six). Optional: image (under docs/, e.g. images/editor_overview.png). scripts/docs/check_docs.py validates this file.

features.title: A real editor
features.description: Dockable panels, scene tabs, multi-select, gizmos with snapping, undo for every edit, a command palette and rebindable shortcuts.

features.title: Lua that reloads live
features.description: Gameplay in Lua 5.4: scripts reload while the game runs, with completion, hover docs, rename and a debugger in the built-in Code tab.

features.title: LDtk level editor built in
features.description: Edit .ldtk projects in place: worlds, IntGrid, tiles, LDtk's auto-layer rule engine, entities and fields - byte-exact round trips with LDtk.

features.title: Export everywhere
features.description: Standalone games for macOS, Windows, Linux and the web from any editor - no compiler, no SDKs to install.

features.title: Skeletal animation
features.description: Spine and DragonBones exports on the engine's own runtime: meshes, skins, IK, events and crossfades.

features.title: Vector art
features.description: SVGs from Inkscape, Illustrator, Affinity or Figma, crisp at any zoom and reloaded when you save: gradients, dashes, clip paths, exact fill rules, cached on the GPU (100 assets in under 1 ms); characters from layers - symbols, part swapping, lip-sync from Rhubarb cues, brightness and colour effects - shape tweens, trim paths, Flash-style filters (drop shadow, glow, outline, blur, colour adjust), constant-width outlines, art that bends with skeleton bones (GPU skinning, IK) and squash-and-stretch warps, physics colliders from the art and destructible carving, path queries, plus drawing from Lua with on_draw.

features.title: Audio mixer
features.description: Buses with faders, pan, mute / solo and effects - EQ, filters, compressor, delay, reverb - and a DAW-style Mixer tab.

features.title: Nodes for everything 2D
features.description: Sprites, tile maps, cameras, Box2D physics bodies and joints, particles, lights, text, dialogue, UI widgets - 60 node types.

features.title: Animation timeline
features.description: Frame and property tracks with Bezier key curves, method and sound events, and onion skinning in the viewport.

features.title: Aseprite files as they are
features.description: Drop in .aseprite files: tags, layers, slices and tilemaps are read directly and reload when you save.

features.title: Virtual cameras
features.description: Priorities and blends, group, path and dead-zone following, LDtk room limits and trauma-based shake.

features.title: Navigation
features.description: Path finding on tile maps, LDtk levels and baked regions; agents with radius, avoidance and doors.

features.title: Paths and followers
features.description: Bezier paths edited in the viewport for moving platforms, patrols and rails.

features.title: State machines
features.description: A visual state graph with transition guards, driving animations and gameplay from Lua.

features.title: Pixel-perfect rendering
features.description: Integer scaling, pixel snapping and a smooth sub-pixel camera for crisp pixel art.

features.title: Gamepads and local co-op
features.description: Four players, hot-plug, native rumble and button prompts that match the controller.

features.title: Input rebinding
features.description: Actions players can rebind in game, with conflict handling, saving and gamepad-navigable menus.

features.title: Accessibility
features.description: UI scale, colour-blind filters, subtitles and captions, and screen-shake scaling - per player.

features.title: Live game inspection
features.description: See and edit the running game's scene tree and properties from the editor, then apply changes back to the scene.

features.title: Editor plugins
features.description: Extend the editor in Lua: commands, dockable panels, inspectors, viewport overlays and importers.

features.title: Global events
features.description: An event bus: Events.emit from anywhere, Events.connect from anywhere - no references between gameplay, UI and game flow.

features.title: Object pooling
features.description: Reuse bullets and effects with Pool.take, spawn / despawn hooks, prewarming and caps.

features.title: Sprite atlases
features.description: Textures packed into atlas pages on export for fewer draw calls - without changing your project.

features.title: Crash reports
features.description: Crashes write a report with the stack and recent log; the editor offers to file it as a GitHub issue.

features.title: Templates
features.description: Start from a complete small game: platformer, top-down RPG, shoot 'em up or Sokoban puzzle.
